records.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Scholarship - Bioceb (European Master in Biological and Chemical Engineering for a Sustainable Bioeconomy)

validation.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO THE SHARD. The shard's official_source_url https://www.master-bioceb.eu does not resolve at all (NXDOMAIN for master-bioceb.eu, www.master-bioceb.eu, bioceb-master.eu and master.bioceb.eu). The live official programme site is https://www.bioceb.eu, whose page title is 'Bioceb - European Master in Biological and Chemical Engineering for a Sustainable Bioeconomy' and whose body carries the programme navigation, the Erasmus Mundus / Erasmus+ / 'Co-funded by the European Union' marks and the five partner universities (Aalto, AgroParisTech, Universite de Liege, TalTech, URCA) - all consistent with this record. The selected asset is that site's masthead logo, in the page markup as . Dimensions declared in markup and confirmed by decoding: 970x400 px, Content-Type image/png, 31556 bytes. Verified accessible at HTTP 200 both with and without the ?1780672359 cache-buster (identical 31556-byte response), and the clean URL is submitted. CAVEAT FOR INTEGRATION: www.bioceb.eu sits behind bot protection - plain curl and Invoke-WebRequest both receive HTTP 503 with a 'Test de securite / Security check' interstitial, while a real browser engine receives HTTP 200. Validation above was performed with a real browser fetch plus in-page fetch(). Any downstream fetcher that re-validates this URL with a non-browser client should expect the 503. NAME-COLLISION WARNING: www.biocev.eu (one 'e', resolved to 147.231.236.169) is a completely different organisation - BIOCEV, a biotechnology research centre in Vestec, Czech Republic, publishing its own logo at https://www.biocev.eu/assets/front/img/logo_new.svg. It is NOT the Bioceb master's programme and its logo was rejected as wrong identity. A careless re-run that resolves biocev.eu instead of bioceb.eu would attach the wrong organisation's mark to this record.

records.title: Beca Interna Postdoctoral - Convocatoria Becas 2026 (CONICET)

validation.notes: CONICET could not be reached by any method, so no official asset could be proven. DNS resolves - both www.conicet.gov.ar and convocatorias.conicet.gov.ar resolve to 45.71.5.46 - but the host accepts no TCP connection. Six-plus attempts across three independent clients all failed: curl.exe returned 'Failed to connect to www.conicet.gov.ar:443/80' (exit 7 connection refused, exit 28 timeout) on repeated tries; Invoke-WebRequest returned 'Unable to connect to the remote server' at 45-second and 60-second timeouts; a real Chromium browser engine returned net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED and net::ERR_ABORTED. Connecting directly to 45.71.5.46 with a Host: www.conicet.gov.ar header also failed on both 443 and 80, and Test-NetConnection to port 443 returned False. Sibling hosts were also probed and are equally unusable: ri.conicet.gov.ar timed out, conicet.gov.ar (apex) refused, sede.conicet.gov.ar and www.conicet.edu.ar do not resolve. Because I never obtained a single byte from an official conicet.gov.ar page, I cannot prove that any candidate file is an official CONICET mark rather than a third-party copy, so image_url stays null. No aggregator, mirror, cached copy or social avatar was substituted - official absence beats fake branding. Recommended action: re-run this record when the CONICET host is reachable; the institutional mark is very likely present at that point.

examined: https://45.71.5.46/ (direct IP, Host: www.conicet.gov.ar, ports 443 and 80)
